svg.title: E-Ticket complete UI direction, version two
svg.desc: Nine Figma-importable vector mockups: login, sign-up, packages, user dashboard, ticket card, payment, withdrawals, admin overview, and admin criteria. This is illustrative design only.
svg.text: Direction 02 · warm ivory, deep violet and mint · nine linked product screens

g.text: Use your email and password to continue.
Sign-in itself never initiates a payment.
Use your name and email to get started.
Registration creates an account, not a ticket or wallet credit.
Compare included series, availability and server price before checkout.
Sample titles and prices. Inventory and final order price are checked by the backend.
Tickets, orders and wallet status in one clear place.
Choose tickets, review the price, then follow payment status.
Continue checkout to see the latest status.
A card-style ticket with honest result status.
No gesture can change the outcome.
Published proof includes seed commitment, reveal and reproducible selection.
Method selection is not a paid order.
No method is paid without server-confirmed settlement.
See eligibility and locked funds before requesting.
A request first places a hold.
Server counts guide review; they are not payment verification.
UTR, screenshot or receiver statement alone never settles a payment.

svg.text: Inter · 8px spacing scale · violet #5446A4 · ink #20223B · mint #D9F4C2 · warm canvas #F5F5F1
All screens are illustrative. They do not create accounts, orders, payments, tickets, withdrawals or admin decisions.
